fit_reason: Whole boat (1978 Tiara 25 ft cruiser on trailer) listed by a private owner in boats by owner; engine issues are mechanical and not ours, but the hull and cockpit can be detailed.
findings: Hull gelcoat along the port and starboard sides looks dull and flat with no reflection, consistent with oxidation
Faded, uneven tone on the hull sides and transom area near the Tiara 2500 graphics
Grime and dark streaking along the lower hull and keel area
Cockpit cluttered with tools, a jacket and loose items piled on the port seat
Dusty, dull vinyl seats and cockpit surfaces with dirt on the cockpit floor
Hazy windshield and dirty dash area around the helm
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1978 Tiara Vacationer. From the photos the hull gelcoat looks pretty dull and chalky, and the cockpit seats and floor could use a good cleaning once the tools are cleared out. We do mobile gelcoat polish and interior details and can come to you before you show it to buyers. Would you like a quote?
